summary.text: Mike Kahoe is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat J. Noah Spinner for an open seat.
Ballotpedia describes him as a former workforce program manager for the Ohio Governor's Office of Workforce Transformation and lists a prior at-large position with the Revere Local School District.
